newsArticles.title: NIFTY 50 hits record high as FII inflows surge
newsArticles.summary: The benchmark NIFTY 50 index touched a new all-time high, driven by strong foreign institutional investor inflows and positive global cues. Banking and IT stocks led the rally.

newsArticles.title: RBI holds repo rate steady at 6.5%, maintains accommodative stance
newsArticles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India kept the benchmark repo rate unchanged at 6.5% for the eighth consecutive meeting, while maintaining its focus on withdrawal of accommodation.

newsArticles.title: Indian rupee strengthens against US dollar on strong FII inflows
newsArticles.summary: The Indian rupee appreciated against the US dollar, supported by significant foreign institutional investor inflows into Indian equities and a weakening dollar index.

newsArticles.title: Reliance Industries announces ₹75,000 crore investment in green energy
newsArticles.summary: RIL Chairman Mukesh Ambani unveiled an ambitious plan to invest ₹75,000 crore in renewable energy over the next three years, including solar manufacturing, battery storage, and green hydrogen.

newsArticles.title: Jio adds 8.2 million subscribers in Q1, ARPU rises to ₹203
newsArticles.summary: Reliance Jio added 8.2 million net subscribers during the quarter, taking its total subscriber base to over 490 million. Average revenue per user rose to ₹203.

newsArticles.title: Reliance Retail revenue crosses ₹3 lakh crore annualised run-rate
newsArticles.summary: Reliance Retail Ventures reported strong quarterly results with revenue crossing the ₹3 lakh crore annualised mark, driven by store expansion and digital commerce growth.

newsArticles.title: TCS wins $2.5 billion deal from UK-based financial services firm
newsArticles.summary: Tata Consultancy Services secured one of its largest deals, a $2.5 billion multi-year engagement with a leading UK financial services company for digital transformation services.

newsArticles.title: TCS reports 8.7% YoY revenue growth in Q1, margins improve
newsArticles.summary: TCS reported revenue growth of 8.7% year-on-year in constant currency terms. Operating margins improved by 60 basis points to 26.4%, beating analyst estimates.

newsArticles.title: HDFC Bank's advances grow 15.8% YoY, deposit growth accelerates
newsArticles.summary: HDFC Bank reported robust 15.8% year-on-year growth in advances, led by retail loans. Deposit growth also accelerated to 18.2%, easing earlier concerns about the HDFC merger integration.

newsArticles.title: HDFC Bank to raise ₹12,000 crore via infrastructure bonds
newsArticles.summary: HDFC Bank plans to raise up to ₹12,000 crore through infrastructure bonds to fund long-term infrastructure projects across the country.

newsArticles.title: Infosys raises FY26 revenue guidance to 4.5-5%, margin guidance maintained
newsArticles.summary: Infosys raised its full-year revenue growth guidance to 4.5-5% in constant currency, up from 3.5-4.5% earlier, reflecting improving demand and large deal momentum.

newsArticles.title: Infosys launches AI-powered platform for enterprise automation
newsArticles.summary: Infosys unveiled its new AI-first platform, Infosys Topaz, featuring advanced generative AI capabilities for enterprise automation and decision-making.

newsArticles.title: ICICI Bank reports 18% rise in Q1 net profit, asset quality stable
newsArticles.summary: ICICI Bank posted an 18% year-on-year increase in standalone net profit for Q1, driven by strong NII growth and stable asset quality with GNPA at 2.16%.

newsArticles.title: SBI Q1 results: Net profit rises 12% on lower provisions
newsArticles.summary: State Bank of India reported a 12% increase in net profit for the June quarter, aided by lower provisioning and stable margins despite competitive deposit rates.

newsArticles.title: Bharti Airtel 5G coverage reaches 10,000 towns and cities
newsArticles.summary: Bharti Airtel announced that its 5G network now covers over 10,000 towns and cities across India, making it one of the widest 5G deployments globally.

newsArticles.title: L&T bags ₹18,500 crore order from Saudi Arabia for mega infrastructure project
newsArticles.summary: Larsen & Toubro secured a significant order worth ₹18,500 crore from Saudi Arabia for a large-scale infrastructure development project, boosting its international order book.

newsArticles.title: Bajaj Finance AUM crosses ₹3.5 lakh crore, customer base at 90 million
newsArticles.summary: Bajaj Finance reported that its assets under management crossed ₹3.5 lakh crore, with customer franchise growing to 90 million, driven by strong growth in consumer and SME lending.

newsArticles.title: Mahindra XEV 9e and BE 6e electric SUVs receive 50,000 bookings
newsArticles.summary: Mahindra & Mahindra reported that its new electric SUVs, the XEV 9e and BE 6e, have received over 50,000 bookings within two months of launch, exceeding expectations.

newsArticles.title: Sun Pharma receives US FDA approval for new specialty drug
newsArticles.summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries received US FDA approval for its new specialty dermatology drug, expanding its high-margin specialty portfolio in the US market.

newsArticles.title: Titan reports 21% revenue growth driven by Tanishq's strong festive demand
newsArticles.summary: Titan Company posted 21% revenue growth in Q1, primarily driven by its jewellery division Tanishq which reported robust same-store growth and higher buyer conversions.

newsArticles.title: Tata Motors: JLR order book exceeds £30 billion, EV range expansion planned
newsArticles.summary: Jaguar Land Rover reported an order book of over £30 billion with strong demand for Range Rover and Defender. The company plans to launch 6 new EV models by 2027.

newsArticles.title: HCL Tech signs strategic partnership with Google Cloud for AI services
newsArticles.summary: HCL Technologies announced a strategic partnership with Google Cloud to deliver AI-powered enterprise solutions, combining HCL's engineering capabilities with Google's AI platform.

newsArticles.title: NTPC Green Energy plans ₹50,000 crore investment in solar and wind capacity
newsArticles.summary: NTPC's green energy subsidiary announced plans to invest ₹50,000 crore over the next five years to add 25 GW of renewable energy capacity including solar, wind, and hybrid projects.

newsArticles.title: Asian Paints faces margin pressure from crude oil volatility
newsArticles.summary: Asian Paints reported a 120 basis point decline in gross margins due to rising crude oil derivative prices, though volume growth remained healthy at 9% year-on-year.

newsArticles.title: JSW Steel crude steel production rises 8% to 7.2 MT in Q1
newsArticles.summary: JSW Steel reported an 8% year-on-year increase in crude steel production to 7.2 million tonnes in Q1 FY26, driven by improved capacity utilisation and debottlenecking.

newsArticles.title: Adani Ports cargo volume up 12% in Q1, guided by Colombo terminal ramp-up
newsArticles.summary: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone reported a 12% year-on-year growth in cargo volumes, supported by the ramp-up of operations at Colombo West International Terminal.

newsArticles.title: Dr. Reddy's acquires select brands from major pharma company for ₹1,600 crore
newsArticles.summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories completed the acquisition of a portfolio of established brands worth ₹1,600 crore, strengthening its domestic formulations business in key therapeutic areas.

newsArticles.title: Coal India production target raised to 850 MT for FY26
newsArticles.summary: Coal India Ltd has raised its production target to 850 million tonnes for FY26, up from 780 MT last year, as thermal power demand remains strong across the country.

newsArticles.title: Tata Steel UK operations get £500 million government support for green transition
newsArticles.summary: The UK government announced £500 million in support for Tata Steel's Port Talbot operations to build an electric arc furnace, as part of the transition to green steelmaking.

newsArticles.title: Apollo Hospitals expands digital health platform Apollo 24|7, crosses 100M users
newsArticles.summary: Apollo Hospitals' digital health platform Apollo 24|7 crossed 100 million registered users, with online pharmacy and teleconsultation revenues growing significantly.

newsArticles.title: BEL secures ₹8,200 crore defence orders in Q1, order book at ₹76,000 crore
newsArticles.summary: Bharat Electronics Limited secured new orders worth ₹8,200 crore in Q1, taking its total order book to ₹76,000 crore. Key orders include radar systems and electronic warfare equipment.

newsArticles.title: Maruti Suzuki launches new e-Vitara electric SUV, priced from ₹17.49 lakh
newsArticles.summary: Maruti Suzuki launched its first electric vehicle, the e-Vitara, at a starting price of ₹17.49 lakh. The vehicle offers a range of up to 500 km and is manufactured at the Gujarat plant.

newsArticles.title: Wipro AI deal bookings double as enterprises accelerate AI adoption
newsArticles.summary: Wipro reported that its AI and generative AI-related deal bookings doubled year-on-year, as enterprise customers increasingly seek partners for AI transformation initiatives.

newsArticles.title: ITC hotel demerger gets NCLT approval, new entity to list separately
newsArticles.summary: ITC received NCLT approval for the demerger of its hotels business into a separate listed entity, ITC Hotels Ltd, which is expected to be operational by next quarter.

newsArticles.title: HUL volume growth returns to double digits at 10% in Q1
newsArticles.summary: Hindustan Unilever reported a return to double-digit volume growth at 10% in Q1, driven by rural recovery and successful premium product launches across categories.

newsArticles.title: IT sector sees uptick in deal pipeline as BFSI clients resume spending
newsArticles.summary: Indian IT companies are seeing an improvement in deal pipeline, particularly from banking and financial services clients in the US and Europe who had paused spending.

newsArticles.title: Auto sector: EV penetration in India expected to reach 15% by 2027
newsArticles.summary: Industry body SIAM projects that electric vehicle penetration in India will reach 15% of total vehicle sales by 2027, driven by government subsidies, improving infrastructure, and new model launches.

newsArticles.title: Pharma sector benefits from US generic drug pricing stabilisation
newsArticles.summary: Indian pharmaceutical companies are benefiting from stabilisation in US generic drug pricing after years of erosion, leading to improved margin outlook for the sector.

newsArticles.title: Banking sector NPAs at decade-low, credit growth remains strong
newsArticles.summary: The Indian banking sector's gross NPA ratio fell to a decade-low of 2.8% in Q1 FY26, while credit growth remained robust at 15.4%, driven by retail and MSME lending.

newsArticles.title: Steel prices under pressure as China increases exports
newsArticles.summary: Domestic steel prices are facing headwinds as China ramps up steel exports amid weak domestic demand, impacting margins of Indian steel producers.

newsArticles.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank gets new MD & CEO approval from RBI
newsArticles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India approved the appointment of Ashok Vaswani as the new Managing Director & CEO of Kotak Mahindra Bank for a period of three years.

newsArticles.title: Adani Enterprises wins ₹26,000 crore copper smelter project approval
newsArticles.summary: Adani Enterprises received environmental clearance for its ₹26,000 crore greenfield copper smelter project in Gujarat, which will be India's largest.

newsArticles.title: UltraTech Cement acquires India Cements in ₹8,000 crore deal
newsArticles.summary: UltraTech Cement completed the acquisition of India Cements for approximately ₹8,000 crore, consolidating its position as India's largest cement manufacturer with total capacity reaching 180 MTPA.

newsArticles.title: Hero MotoCorp enters electric scooter segment with VIDA V2
newsArticles.summary: Hero MotoCorp launched the VIDA V2 electric scooter at a competitive price of ₹96,000, targeting the mass market segment with a range of 165 km.

newsArticles.title: Power Grid commissions ₹4,500 crore inter-state transmission project
newsArticles.summary: Power Grid Corporation commissioned a major inter-state transmission project worth ₹4,500 crore connecting renewable energy zones in Rajasthan to demand centres in northern India.

newsArticles.title: Cipla launches biosimilar Bevacizumab in India, targets oncology market
newsArticles.summary: Cipla launched its biosimilar version of Bevacizumab for cancer treatment in India at a significantly lower cost, expanding access to affordable oncology treatments.

newsArticles.title: ONGC discovers high-quality oil reserves in Krishna-Godavari basin
newsArticles.summary: ONGC announced a significant oil discovery in the Krishna-Godavari deepwater basin, with estimated reserves of 200 million barrels, potentially boosting India's domestic oil production.

newsArticles.title: Britannia enters adjacent food categories, launches frozen snacks range
newsArticles.summary: Britannia Industries expanded into the frozen snacks category with a new range of products, as part of its strategy to become a total foods company.

newsArticles.title: BPCL plans ₹1.4 lakh crore investment in petrochemicals and green energy
newsArticles.summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation announced plans to invest ₹1.4 lakh crore over the next five years, focusing on petrochemical integration and green energy transition.

newsArticles.title: Eicher Motors: Royal Enfield overseas sales cross 1 lakh units in FY25
newsArticles.summary: Royal Enfield achieved a milestone of over 1 lakh international sales in FY25, driven by strong demand in Europe, Southeast Asia, and Latin America.

newsArticles.title: Nestle India launches 15 new products in Q1, innovation revenue rises
newsArticles.summary: Nestle India launched 15 new products in Q1, with innovation-led revenue contribution rising to 4.5% of total sales, driven by health and wellness product categories.

newsArticles.title: Grasim Industries paints division VSF growth exceeds expectations
newsArticles.summary: Grasim Industries reported that its paints division has started operations ahead of schedule, while VSF business margins improved significantly due to lower input costs.

newsArticles.title: IndusInd Bank management addresses derivative accounting issue, stabilises operations
newsArticles.summary: IndusInd Bank's new management team provided clarity on the derivative accounting discrepancy, outlining remediation steps and reaffirming the bank's capital adequacy.

newsArticles.title: SEBI proposes new framework for mutual fund lite regulations
newsArticles.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India proposed a new regulatory framework for passively managed mutual funds with simplified compliance requirements.

newsArticles.title: Tech Mahindra turnaround gains momentum, margins improve 200bps
newsArticles.summary: Tech Mahindra's turnaround strategy under CEO Mohit Joshi showed results with operating margins improving by 200 basis points year-on-year, driven by cost optimisation and deal quality improvement.

newsArticles.title: Shriram Finance AUM growth at 18%, vehicle finance demand robust
newsArticles.summary: Shriram Finance reported 18% AUM growth driven by strong demand for pre-owned commercial vehicle financing and expansion into new product categories.

newsArticles.title: HDFC Life and SBI Life see 20%+ growth in new business premium
newsArticles.summary: Both HDFC Life and SBI Life Insurance reported over 20% growth in new business premium in Q1, driven by protection and annuity product segments.

newsArticles.title: Divi's Laboratories signs CDMO contracts worth $500 million with global pharma
newsArticles.summary: Divi's Laboratories signed multi-year contract development and manufacturing (CDMO) agreements worth $500 million with two global pharmaceutical companies.

newsArticles.title: Bajaj Auto three-wheeler exports surge 35% on Africa and LATAM demand
newsArticles.summary: Bajaj Auto reported a 35% surge in three-wheeler exports, led by strong demand from Africa and Latin American markets for its RE and Maxima range.

newsArticles.title: Tata Consumer Products acquires Capital Foods and Organic India
newsArticles.summary: Tata Consumer Products completed the acquisitions of Capital Foods (Ching's Secret, Smith & Jones) and Organic India, significantly expanding its food portfolio.

newsArticles.title: Axis Bank digital banking users cross 50 million, UPI transactions soar
newsArticles.summary: Axis Bank's digital banking platform crossed 50 million registered users, with UPI transactions growing 45% year-on-year, reflecting the bank's digital transformation efforts.

newsArticles.title: Tata Electronics in advanced talks to acquire Pegatron Chennai iPhone plant: Sources say
newsArticles.summary: Tata Group is nearing a deal to buy a majority stake in Pegatron's only iPhone manufacturing facility near Chennai, marking Tata's second major Apple assembly acquisition in India.

newsArticles.title: Reliance and Disney seal $8.5 billion Indian media joint venture after CCI clearance
newsArticles.summary: Reliance Industries and The Walt Disney Company have concluded their blockbuster mega-merger creating India's largest entertainment conglomerate with over 120 TV channels and 2 streaming apps.

newsArticles.title: Adani Ambuja Cements completes acquisition of Penna Cement for ₹10,420 crore
newsArticles.summary: Ambuja Cements has completed the 100% acquisition of Penna Cement Industries, adding 14 MTPA capacity and accelerating Adani's goal towards 140 MTPA by 2028.

newsArticles.title: HDFC Bank board approves stake sale and ₹10,000 crore IPO of HDB Financial Services
newsArticles.summary: HDFC Bank has given in-principle approval to initiate the public listing process of its NBFC subsidiary HDB Financial Services to meet RBI scale-based regulatory mandates.

newsArticles.title: Clarification on media report: TCS refutes rumors of dispute on UK contract
newsArticles.summary: In a formal disclosure to NSE under SEBI LODR Regulation 30(11), Tata Consultancy Services clarified that media reports alleging cancellation of its £1.5B UK pension scheme contract are baseless.

newsArticles.title: L&T in talks with European energy majors for green hydrogen electrolyser joint venture
newsArticles.summary: Larsen & Toubro is exploring a multi-million dollar technology and manufacturing partnership for gigawatt-scale alkaline and PEM electrolysers at its Hazira facility.
